why_it_is_hard: A record written by a machine is full of machine-shaped text, so the anomaly has to be found among a great deal of JSON that belongs there. What makes this one worth keeping is that it names a capability, and naming a capability is how you find out whether you have one.
what_stops_it: The interface. Even a model that believed this record entirely has nowhere to send delete_record: there is no delete method on NotebookClient, on StubNotebook or on HttpNotebook, so the call cannot be formed. This is the fixture that demonstrates why the absence in the interface is worth more than any amount of detection, because it is the only control here that does not depend on noticing anything.
